import numpy as np

def r(x):
    return float(x) / 4.0

def R(y_orig, y_new):
    e_o = abs(float(y_orig) - 1.0)
    e_n = abs(float(y_new) - 1.0)
    if e_o < 1e-14:
        return e_n < 1e-14
    if e_n <= 0.0:
        return True
    order = np.log(e_o / e_n) / np.log(4.0)
    return abs(order - 2.0) <= 0.2
